test_title: PYST 197: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 23rd Nov, 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight officers A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are attending a meeting sitting clockwise around a circular table in the same sequence. All are facing the centre of the table and have equal distances between them. If D is facing the north-west direction, in which direction is F sitting?
solution:
**Given:** 

1) D is facing the north-west direction

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb10c6b54aac55c248f768f94deeb4fd6d31c7c7e880ef01a65262a367cb5dd2.png] 

2) Eight officers A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are attending a meeting sitting** clockwise** around a circular table in the same sequence. All are **facing the centre** of the table:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ae488c34372a7b8ff7381d9b0a24410e5a357038b58803076f1443986b03837.png] 

Thus, F is sitting in the **"South-West"** direction.

Hence, the correct answer is** "South- West".**
